title: marp-GUI: text-first slide authoring with direct-manipulation write-back and design-rule linting
description: marp-GUI is a workspace for writing presentation slides as plain Marp Markdown in Visual Studio Code. Its synchronized preview writes every gesture (in-place text editing, slide operations, box dragging, layout switching, slide insertion) back into the Markdown source as one undoable edit. Themes expose design rules as CSS variables and one-word layout classes, a lint checks slide-design rules per slide, a library indexes and reuses slides across decks, and a chunked builder produces vector PDFs of long decks.
